name: guidon-app
description: GUIDON packaging: installable PWA bundle, standalone single file, Windows desktop app, Android app

scripts.test: npm run build && npm run verify && npm run test:points && npm run test:consistency && npm run test:calendar && npm run test:leader && npm run test:privacy && npm run test:scrollhint && npm run test:theater && npm run test:flip && npm run test:a11y && npm run test:pdf && npm run test:standalone && npm run test:bridge && npm run test:contrast && npm run test:responsive && npm run test:csp
scripts.android:sync: npm run build && cap sync android
scripts.android:debug: npm run android:sync && cd android && gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.android:release: npm run android:sync && cd android && gradlew assembleRelease bundleRelease
scripts._note: test:android* need a running device/emulator + adb forward tcp:9222 localabstract:webview_devtools_remote_<pid>
